notes: Lead from organic search + self-serve signup. Small boutique home & stationery e-comm (direct-to-consumer). Primary asks: on-site product Q&A widget (answer product-specific questions), bulk catalog enrichment (auto-generate short descriptions + tags), and embeddings for site search. Traffic profile: steady low-volume with large promotional spikes during new drops (typically 5-10x for 2-4 hours). Customer emphasized cost sensitivity — "we need answers to be accurate but can trade off model size for cost during off-peak". Wants 2-week POC using hosted API only; prefer public cloud. Latency SLOs: interactive UI target ~150-300ms median for short responses, willing to accept slightly higher tail latency on big prompts. Throughput: baseline ~5k API calls/day, spike to ~50k calls/day during launches. Model preference: small/efficient open models or quantized variants (mention Llama2/Alpaca-style or Mistral small-family) and fallback to cheaper smaller variant during heavy spikes. Routing: wants simple cost-based fallback, not multi-region. Security: SMB but requires SSO for admin console and audit logs for billing; asked about SOC2 status and data retention policy (30-90 days). POC success criteria: 1) FAQ accuracy > 85% on product Q&A test set, 2) catalog enrichment reduces manual title/desc edits by 60%, 3) cost per active session under defined threshold.
